variant_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: design comparison sheet of EIGHT new rustic cozy farming RPG production stations, TWO variants each. Landscape 4-column by 4-row board, 16 clean separated standalone sprite concepts. Upper two rows variants A1-A8 (simple practical rustic timber and wrought iron workshop). Lower two rows variants B1-B8 (more compact enclosed timber cabinets on low stone feet). Same warm painterly outlined style, modest crisp detail, smooth sprites, slightly elevated south-facing orthographic camera. Each object entirely inside its cell, generous gutters, consistent small ground footprint. Objects in reading order within each variant: 1 fruit-and-oil screw press with wood basket and small jug; 2 fermentation barrels with a tidy work shelf, fermentation airlocks; 3 preserve/pickling worktable with small warm pot and jars; 4 small wood-and-brick smoking cabinet with chimney, front opening and tiny woodfire chamber below; 5 wooden textile loom showing a cloth warp, shuttle and yarn; 6 leatherworker frame and curing vat with leather sheets and tools, no animals; 7 candle-and-soap workbench with wax pot, moulds and several plain candles; 8 compost/gardening workbench with small covered compost bin, seed sieves, clay tray and scoop. A styles open/simple, B compact/enclosed but same practical rustic palette. No magic motifs. No people, no gore, no corpses, no copied game artwork, no setting background, no UI border. Small readable corner labels above each object exactly A1 A2 A3 A4 on row1, A5 A6 A7 A8 on row2, B1 B2 B3 B4 row3, B5 B6 B7 B8 row4. Warm ivory letters on tiny dark brown badge. This is a proposal board; background quiet neutral parchment is okay, objects remain visually separate. Exact 16 objects.
